title: Bunch Of Optimization/BOO
description: BOO is a Modpack is a bunch of optimization for us users with potato pc
body:
BOO: Bunch of Optimization

BOO is the ultimate performance booster for your game, combining a collection of optimization mods into one seamless package. Built heavily around Vulkan, it maximizes efficiency and stability, helping your game run smoother than ever.

Designed for both power and compatibility, BOO works perfectly alongside Bobby, giving you the best of both worlds: enhanced performance without sacrificing your favorite mods. Whether you’re looking to cut down stutters, improve frame rates, or simply enjoy a more stable experience, BOO has you covered.

⚠️ Friendly reminder: Some lag may still occur, especially with particles—but don’t worry! You can tweak these settings in Particle Core via the mod menu to find the balance that works best for you.

Get ready to play smarter, faster, and smoother—BOO makes optimization a breeze!
